top_choice_rationale: Effective-one-body theory and stable numerical simulations address complementary parts of the same difficult problem, and their predictive role has been tested against observed gravitational-wave signals. The bounded claim has strong scientific maturity, with identifiable foundational contributions, though the historical division of credit merits review.
recusal_note: I have coauthored work with Ursula Keller's group, a professional connection to a proposed P002 laureate. This simulation does not adjudicate recusals.
